dedupe_keys.name: photographs and locations of 100 stone masonry buildings in the urla peninsula izmir

description: This dataset records 100 traditional stone masonry buildings in the Urla Peninsula of İzmir, Türkiye, with one photograph of each and a spreadsheet of location and seismic hazard values. It was published on Harvard Dataverse on 22 April 2025 by Yavuz Selim Karavin, Yener Kahraman, Nefise Akdag and Ugur Demir, with support from TÜBİTAK grant 124M705 and the İzmir Institute of Technology research fund. The Excel file gives province, district, neighbourhood, usage type and estimated age for each building, with spectral accelerations Ss and S1 from the official Turkish Earthquake Hazard Map of AFAD; the 100 JPEG photographs document architectural character. Coverage: 100 buildings in the Urla Peninsula. Access: Harvard Dataverse, one spreadsheet and 100 images. Licence: CC0 1.0; free. Caveats: building ages are estimates, and structural details beyond typology are not recorded. Simulation uses: seismic vulnerability studies of historic masonry and heritage building inventories in the Aegean region. Related records: the Izmir flood exposure dataset and the PUMA masonry cyclic test.
